name: std::basic_ostringstream::swap
intro:
Exchanges the state of the stream with those of other.

This is done by calling basic_ostream<CharT, Traits>::swap(other) and rdbuf()->swap(*other.rdbuf()).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
other

 -

  stream to exchange the state with

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Use an in-memory stream holding 42, then move and swap its state.

summary: Exchanges the state of the stream with those of other.
